description: core §2.7 (0.25), whether a window lost no delivery: the resource's declared QoS (`qos.reliability`: best_effort or reliable; `qos.congestion`: drop or block), the deliveries the window's own reader lost (`reader_lost`: its queue overflowed or fell behind, or a cap kept them out of its count), and miss detection (`miss_detection.declared`: the resource declares `history.miss_detection_ms`; `used`: the window's subscription detects misses; `misses`: how many it detected) → whether the window is shown to have lost no delivery (`expect.lossless`) and the reason class (`expect.reason`). Miss detection counts only when the resource declares it and the subscription uses it; a detected miss is a loss, and none detected establishes nothing. Reasons are chosen in this order: reader_lost (reader_lost above 0); misses_detected (declared and used, misses above 0); best_effort (reliability best_effort, whatever the congestion); congestion_drop (reliable with drop); else lossless, reliable_block. Only reliable_block is lossless.

cases.note: reliable and block, nothing lost by the reader: a router's queue never drops such a sample, so the window lost none
reliable and block, but the reader's own queue fell behind
best effort and drop: a sample dropped on the path leaves no trace
best effort with block: a best-effort sample is droppable whatever its congestion
reliable with drop: a full queue drops a sample and leaves no trace
the reader's own loss comes before the QoS
the reader's own loss comes before a detected miss
best effort, miss detection used and nothing detected: no detected miss establishes nothing, since a publisher none of whose samples arrived is never reported
best effort, misses detected: a loss shown, and named before the QoS
reliable and block, yet a miss detected: positive evidence of a loss wins over the QoS
reliable and block, miss detection used and nothing detected: lossless by the QoS
declared, but the window's subscription does not detect misses: the QoS decides
declared and not used, over a reliable, blocking path: lossless by the QoS
used where the resource does not declare it: its samples carry no number, so there is nothing to detect, and the QoS decides
